company_research.industry: Content & Collaboration Software, Software, Engineering Software, Multimedia, Games & Graphics Software, Product design and development
recent_news: Figma's planned $20 billion acquisition by Adobe fell through in December 2023 due to antitrust concerns. (Source: https://www.forbes.com/companies/figma)

Figma is expanding its London office and hiring more staff, despite a wider tech hiring downturn. (Source: https://www.cityam.com/figma-plots-london-office-expansion-despite-fresh-wave-of-tech-layoffs)
Figma plans to double its NYC-based staff by 2034. (Source: https://finance.yahoo.com/news/design-firm-figma-double-nyc-130000967.html)

Figma has gained new customers, including Anthropic and Prenuvo Inc., and Yum! Brands Inc.'s Taco Bell has substantially expanded its use of Figma in 2024. (Source: https://finance.yahoo.com/news/design-firm-figma-double-nyc-130000967.html)
Figma unveiled Figma AI at its annual user conference, Config, in June. (Source: https://www.forbes.com/companies/figma)
Figma has focused on making its existing product more useful to software engineers with a tool called Dev Mode. (Source: https://finance.yahoo.com/news/design-firm-figma-double-nyc-130000967.html)
Figma announced new product updates at Config 2026, including code layers, Figma Motion, shaders, generative plugins, and Weave tools. (Source: https://www.figma.com/newsroom)
Figma is rolling out updates to its file organization system, replacing 'Projects' with 'Folders' and allowing for nested folders and color-coding. (Source: https://www.figma.com/release-notes)
culture_signals: Praised for its supportive and collaborative atmosphere. (Source: https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Figma-culture-Reviews-EI_IE1537286.0,5_KH6,13.htm)
Employees enjoy a playful culture that fosters innovation. (Source: https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Figma-culture-Reviews-EI_IE1537286.0,5_KH6,13.htm)
Many employees appreciate the bright and humble colleagues. (Source: https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Figma-Reviews-E1537286.htm)
Glassdoor rating of 4.8 out of 5 for culture and values in New York City. (Source: https://www.glassdoor.com/Reviews/Figma-New-York-City-Reviews-EI_IE1537286.0,5_IL.6,19_IM615.htm)
Some Blind and Glassdoor reviews suggest the culture has changed dramatically for the worse since the IPO. (Source: https://www.teamblind.com/post/what-is-working-at-figma-like-pi3t6bft)

Overall Glassdoor employee rating of 3.6 out of 5 stars, with Culture & values at 3.1, Career opportunities at 3.0, Work/Life balance at 2.9, and Senior management at 2.9. (Source: https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Figma-EI_IE1537286.11,16.htm)
company_research.notes: Figma is actively expanding and innovating, particularly in AI and developer tools, following the failed acquisition by Adobe. While some employees express concerns about culture changes post-IPO, many still praise the collaborative and innovative environment.
